text: An executive walking into a QBR meeting needs the answer to how the company did in the first five seconds. This page is built around that, starting with four simple card visuals carrying the headline numbers.

Total Sales, Order Count, Average Order Value, and Total Units each get their own card. A single quarter slicer, built from DimDate, filters every one of them at once, because every measure traces back to the fact table through the relationships built in Lesson 11.

This page deliberately stays company-wide. There's no territory breakdown here on purpose — that's Lesson 14's job, on its own page. Mixing both jobs onto one page would leave neither question cleanly answered.
Next lesson builds that regional drill-down page, taking the Executive from 'how much did we sell' to 'where.'
